findings.title: Local boundary refinement explicitly does not establish semantic closure
findings.description: The refiner joins nearby ASR segments by temporal gaps, bounded side budgets, caps and padding. Fallback can snap to low audio levels; hard cuts are labelled. The code explicitly describes these signals as timing only.
findings.limitations: Does not establish frequency or downstream output quality; not yet traced through every caller.
findings.relevance: Retain as matched baseline and mechanical boundary proposal; do not treat it as a semantic completeness oracle.

findings.title: Director validates cited evidence but does not independently verify all essential context
findings.description: investigate() validates ID membership, retrieval limits and role-ID subsets; role IDs are optional. enforce() derives semantic span from cited evidence, checks section, proposal overlap, evidence intersection, campaign constraints and duplicates. These checks do not establish that a missing qualification or dependency was identified. No independent semantic completeness check occurs in these two functions.
findings.limitations: Static observation of two functions, not proof no other system component ever performs verification. Production caller and export chain need deeper audit.
findings.relevance: Separate interval construction from independent contextual closure judgment; distinguish viewer-required spans from interpretation-only evidence.

findings.title: Benchmark distinguishes temporal span coverage from human contextual completeness
findings.description: benchmark() emits human_context_completeness as unavailable without independent judgments; legacy setup_payoff_completeness alias is explicitly marked temporal_span_coverage_not_contextual_completeness.
findings.limitations: Static audit of metric emission, not verification of all matching logic or independent assessment reliability.
findings.relevance: Reuse coverage metrics with explicit denominators, but keep human judgments and contextual faithfulness separate.

findings.title: CALF explicitly ignores the immediate pre-event region in its context loss
findings.description: Six piecewise zones include a zero-loss pre-event region, post-event positive target and tapered negative penalties. This is not a learned setup/payoff segmentation model.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Adapt role-sensitive supervision, not literal soccer label transfer.

findings.title: TimeRefine predicts quantized endpoints and signed correction velocities
findings.description: v9 inference imposes timestep tokens starting at 0.8, decrementing 0.2, generates endpoint and velocity tokens and combines them arithmetically; returns first/last/mean proposal. No independent evidence or completeness check in this function.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Use bounded refinement as proposal generation, not approval.

findings.title: Time-R1 rewards overlap and optional normalized endpoint accuracy
findings.description: Parser takes last answer block and last numeric pair. Reward is tIoU; v2 multiplies by endpoint factors; format is separately rewarded. This does not enforce meaning, and parser does not validate bounds/order.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: RL requires human closure supervision and strict interval validation.

findings.title: Moment-DETR uses joint normalized span and salience losses
findings.description: Source implements L1 and generalized temporal IoU on center-width spans, or endpoint CE; matching and saliency hinge losses. Joint proposals are valuable, but query match is not contextual closure.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Adapt to hypotheses from InterestLab; keep editorial verification external.

findings.title: ActionFormer uses per-point localization and temporal NMS
findings.description: Source locates focal classification and center-distance IoU regression losses, inference and batched NMS. This is an efficient proposal candidate architecture, not an editorial model.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Train lightweight role-aware temporal head only after annotation readiness.

findings.title: ClipSense inherits completeness from overlapping proposals and recombines boundaries
findings.description: reasoner.py L254-L320 separately clusters and enumerates start/end pairs; L811-L849 sufficiency can be inherited from a transcript flag or any overlapping conversation proposal. Refiner deep-copies candidate and modifies endpoints L379-L392 without recalculating semantic flags in that function.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Reverify each candidate and any changed interval; never copy closure approval across boundaries.

findings.title: TimeRefine checkpoint access is not established by the pinned release
findings.description: Pinned README L14 says checkpoint link removed due to anonymity, conflicting with paper availability statement. No binary download verified.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Defer execution until accessible weights/base-model terms verified.

findings.title: QVHighlights annotation license differs from code license
findings.description: Moment-DETR README L154-L155 states MIT code and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 annotations. Model and underlying video rights remain separately unresolved.
findings.limitations: Static source audit, selected ranges only; no model runtime, full training replication or end-to-end downstream verification.
findings.relevance: Research-only dataset use until rights clearance.
